/* ---------- scene 3 romantic mini-game ---------- */ .love-game{ width:min(92vw,520px); margin:34px auto 18px; padding:24px 18px 22px; text-align:center; border:1px solid rgba(240,195,109,.28); border-radius:24px; background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.075),rgba(224,87,126,.055)); box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.28); position:relative; overflow:hidden; } .love-game::before{ content:""; position:absolute; width:180px;height:180px; border-radius:50%; left:-90px; top:-90px; background:rgba(240,195,109,.08); pointer-events:none; } .game-kicker{ color:var(--gold); font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:6px; } .love-game h2{ font-family:'Marck Script',cursive; color:var(--cream); font-size:clamp(28px,6vw,40px); } .game-intro{ color:var(--blush); font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:17px; margin:5px auto 16px; line-height:1.45; } .secret-hearts{ display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:12px; margin:10px 0 8px; } .secret-heart{ position:relative; width:72px;height:72px; border:1px solid rgba(240,195,109,.38); border-radius:20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); color:white; cursor:pointer; font-size:34px; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition:transform .25s ease, background .25s ease; } .secret-heart span{ position:absolute; right:8px; top:5px; font-size:11px; color:var(--gold); font-family:Poppins,sans-serif; } .secret-heart:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.04)} .secret-heart.revealed{ background:rgba(224,87,126,.22); animation:secretPop .55s ease; cursor:default; } .secret-heart.revealed span{display:none} .secret-heart:disabled{opacity:1} @keyframes secretPop{ 0%{transform:scale(.75) rotate(-8deg)} 55%{transform:scale(1.18) rotate(5deg)} 100%{transform:scale(1)} } .game-progress{ font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; color:rgba(255,255,255,.62); } .clue{ min-height:48px; margin:12px auto 8px; padding:10px 12px; color:var(--cream); font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:19px; line-height:1.45; } .clue.reveal{animation:clueReveal .55s ease} @keyframes clueReveal{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px) scale(.97); filter:blur(3px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none; filter:none} } .unlock{ margin-top:8px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed rgba(240,195,109,.2); opacity:.55; transition:opacity .5s ease; } .unlock.ready{opacity:1} .unlock-icon{font-size:25px; margin-bottom:2px} .unlock-title{font-family:'Marck Script',cursive;color:var(--gold);font-size:21px} .unlock-btn{margin-top:10px!important; font-size:13px!important; padding:11px 20px!important} .unlock-message{ display:none; margin:12px auto 0; max-width:430px; color:var(--cream); font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:20px; line-height:1.55; } .unlock-message.show{display:block;animation:clueReveal .8s ease} .love-game.completed .unlock{ background:rgba(224,87,126,.08); border-radius:16px; border-top-color:rgba(240,195,109,.4); } @media(max-width:420px){ .secret-heart{width:64px;height:64px;font-size:30px} .secret-hearts{gap:8px} }
